title: Animals that glow
text: Some animals can make their own light. This is called bioluminescence. It usually happens because of a special chemical reaction inside their bodies.

Fireflies are the most famous example. On summer nights they often fly over fields and gardens. They flash their lights to find a partner. Each type of firefly has its own pattern of flashes, like a secret code.

Most glowing animals live in the deep ocean. Down there, the sun never arrives and it is always dark. The anglerfish has a small light on its head. Little fish swim towards the light, and then the anglerfish eats them!
Some animals use light to hide. A small squid lives near Hawaii. At night the moon shines on the water, so the squid glows from below. Predators usually do not see its shadow.
On some beaches you can sometimes see blue waves at night. The light comes from millions of tiny living things in the water. When the waves move, they glow. It looks like magic, but it is science!

grammar.title: Grammar: adverbs of frequency
grammar.rule: Adverbs of frequency say how often. They go before the main verb, but after the verb to be.
rows: It is always dark. / They often fly.
items: In the deep ocean it is ___ dark.
Predators ___ do not see the squid.
